value.rationale: The four exceptional cubic symmetric graphs form a natural and widely recognized test family, and the theorem supplies complete cardinality polynomials rather than isolated bounds. The hidden affine fourth parallel class for Pappus and the spanning-tree matroid recovered from Desargues provide structural content and meaningful matroid interpretations outside the sufficient matching hypothesis in the original literature. The jump-vs-slide mobility and non-self-centered Desargues exchange behavior are exact and mathematically motivated.
